author: Napoleon Bonaparte
displayText: “From Bonifacio to Cape Corse, from Ajaccio to Bastia, nothing rises but a chorus of curses against you. Your friends hide, your kin disown you. […]”
sourceTitle: Letter to Matteo Buttafoco, deputy of Corsica, January 1791
archive: Masson & Schütz, Napoléon manuscrits inédits 1786–1791 (Paris, 1908) — public domain (French)
context: The 21-year-old denounces Corsica's deputy: treason itemized in letters of blood. Dated January 1791 in the edition. Translated for Chronicle from the public-domain French; original below.
originalText: Depuis Bonifacio au cap Corse, depuis Ajaccio à Bastia, ce n'est qu'un chorus d'imprécations contre vous. Vos amis se cachent, vos parents vous désavouent.
